mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.amount, e.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, e.memo, e.expense_date, e.expense_time, e.created_at FROM expenses e LEFT JOIN categories c ON e.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
ORDER BY e.created_at ASC, e.id ASC
ORDER BY e.amount DESC, e.id DESC
ORDER BY e.amount ASC, e.id ASC
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.id, e.amount, e.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, e.memo, e.expense_date, e.expense_time, e.created_at FROM expenses e LEFT JOIN categories c ON e.category_id = c.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND ( ( e.expense_date >= #{monthStart} AND e.expense_date < #{nextMonthStart} ) OR ( e.expense_date IS NULL AND e.created_at >= #{createdAtStart} AND e.created_at < #{createdAtEnd} ) ) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT id, amount, category_id, memo, expense_date, expense_time, created_at FROM expenses WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
